mentions.name: Emilia
mentions.description: A personal relationship manager that uses AI to answer natural-language questions about one's contacts and family relationships, such as "who's everybody on my aunt's side?". It is currently in alpha, with a Discord server for early adopters and an open invitation to alpha test via email.
mentions.problem: The author forgets names and family relationships when meeting extended family or fellow soccer parents, and existing relationship managers like Monica HQ or professional/sales-oriented tools with LinkedIn integration don't fit personal use.
mentions.audience: Individuals managing personal and family relationships rather than professional/sales networking
mentions.source_excerpt: Emilia, a personal relationship manager. Every once in a while I meet extended family (wives of cousins or their children) or I meet a fellow soccer parent and I forget their names, or who's related to who.
